args.inactive_reason: Integer column count of the sunlit group, fixed by the wrapper.

args.name: nl
args.inactive_reason: Integer radiation layer count (nz + 1 = 60 on x1.2562), fixed by the wrapper.

args.name: icld
args.inactive_reason: Integer cloud-overlap selector (cldovrlp; 2 = maximum-random on hrrrv5).

args.name: draws
args.inactive_reason: Integer KISS draws per g-point (mcica_draws_per_gpoint: nl for icld 1-2, 1 for 3, 2 nl for 4-5).

args.name: cf
args.inactive_reason: frozen-coefficient: cloud fraction enters only the McICA mask (cloudy = r >= 1 - cf, 3725) and the overlap chain (3722, 3724); the mask is frozen at the trajectory, so its derivative is identically 0 here (the Dirac on the threshold is dropped, range hazard 1)

args.name: iw
args.note: view into the wrapper's layers buffer (rrtmg_sw_v842.py:568); masked copy into out slab 1

args.name: lw
args.note: view into the wrapper's layers buffer (rrtmg_sw_v842.py:568); masked copy into out slab 2

args.name: sw
args.note: view into the wrapper's layers buffer (rrtmg_sw_v842.py:568); masked copy into out slab 3

args.name: seeds
args.inactive_reason: Integer KISS state per column from mpas_sw_mcica_seeds; enters only the cloudy decision (frozen mask). These are the saved McICA samples.

args.name: weights
args.inactive_reason: Exponential-overlap weights (icld >= 4 only; a 1-word dummy otherwise); enter only the comparison r2 < alpha (frozen mask).

args.name: xorshift
args.inactive_reason: Host GF(2) jump table (xorshift_jump_table(draws, 112)); integer, fixed per (draws).

args.name: out

overwrite_mask.basis: capture source 3c499c7b:3725-3726 writes O(0..3,k) for every (c, k, g); slabs 4..7 (band optics defaults, rrtmg_sw_v842.py:548-550) are not written

args.note: slab 0 = 0/1 mask (derivative identically 0 under the frozen mask); slabs 1..3 = masked iw / lw / sw; slabs 4..7 pass through

saved_note: No tape and no stored mask. The McICA samples are reproduced bitwise from the pre-launch cf, seeds, weights and xorshift words, which the window binds as primal pre-launch copies (harness __check: bitwise to the forward image on every captured launch).

branches.rule: cf has zero derivative everywhere in this kernel (it only feeds the mask), so the flush needs no tangent rule

branches.predicate: overlap chain: prev > 1 - prev_cf / r2 < alpha
branches.rule: chain choice frozen at the trajectory; r only feeds the mask

branches.tie: r == 1 - frac is cloudy (forward >=); the derivative there is a Dirac in cf, dropped
branches.rule: mask frozen at the trajectory: d out1/2/3 = mask * d iw/lw/sw, d out0 = 0, d out4..7 pass through

limiters: frozen-coefficient: the 0/1 McICA mask (r >= 1 - cf) and the overlap chain choices are frozen at the trajectory; the linearisation is the exact derivative of the real map off the threshold set and drops the cloud-fraction sensitivity (a step) entirely

refusal.domain: cf finite; every written derivative word finite; 1 <= nl <= 112; 1 <= icld <= 5

precondition: cf / iw / lw / sw are disjoint views (they share the layers allocation; none overlaps out); seeds, weights, xorshift, out are distinct allocations. TL: one thread per (c, g) writes that g-point's slab 0..3 words. AD: one thread per (c, k) reads and zeroes all 112 g-point cotangents of slabs 0..3 of layer k and owns b_iw/b_lw/b_sw(c, k): deterministic, no atomics on data words
precision: TL is a masked copy (bitwise, no arithmetic). AD sums the 112 g-point cotangents per (c, slab, k) in double in ascending g, adds the incoming accumulate word in double, one rounding to f32 (the glue-row rule). The mask comes from the forward's own stream helpers copied verbatim (--fmad=false --ftz=false)
